title: Surreal Caterpillar Ride
description: A man in a top hat and floral jacket carries a large angry yellow chick on his shoulders while riding a giant purple caterpillar with big eyes. The scene is set within a circular frame against a cosmic sky with floating robots, ghosts, and a distant house.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of a stern man wearing a black top hat and a dark jacket covered in colorful flowers, riding a giant purple caterpillar with large cartoon eyes. A large angry yellow chick with a blue feather sits on his shoulder. They travel along a twisted tree branch through a vibrant cosmic landscape with purple ghosts, floating robots, a red house on a hill, and a starry nebula sky, all contained in a circular frame with ornate red border.
